card.name: Words before 'by/via' describing mechanism
card.fires_on: The last word of a physiological or pharmacological process (e.g. blood pressure, metabolized, activation, excretion) right where 'by', 'via' or 'through' with the mechanism would come next.

modes.label: Lower blood pressure
modes.description: The word 'pressure' after 'lower blood', before 'by inhibiting' a pathway.
modes.example: presumably because drugs of both classes lower blood<< pressure>> by inhibiting parts of the renin

modes.label: Ends of process words
modes.description: Final piece of a process or action word such as metabolized, excretion or polymerization, before an agent or pathway.
modes.example: Lonafarnib is metabol<<ized>> by CYP3A. Concom

modes.label: Mediated or activated
modes.description: A passive or process word expecting a mechanism phrase next.
modes.example: n-3 PUFAs modulate T-cell<< activation>> via protein kinase C-alpha and -epsilon

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like 'via' and 'through' that introduce a mechanism.
